But cash matters for rank.

Value of goods: sell r5-6. Produce 2 goods ~ each unit sells ~5-6 alashi later. Shuttle expected ~2.25 goods, risk of losing all.

Influence: end bonus 5% bank (~1.5 alashi) for max influence. Also presidency veto protects from tax laws. Bribe 5 to idx0 (current president, richest) — gives them cash, hurts my rank relatively.

Simpler: take shuttle for more goods (choice 3), moderate risk. Or produce (choice 1) safe. Given cash competition tight (15.2 vs 35+), extra goods value high. Shuttle expected value higher than produce. Take shuttle.
